description: Your own Barmaan apps, subscriptions and licences: reference, kind, product, plan, status (active, expiring, grace, expired, suspended, cancelled, pending, scheduled), days left, dates, seats, domains and how many files you can download. Filter by kind or status, search with query, page with next_cursor. The licence key itself is never returned. An empty list means nothing has been added to your account yet.

cursor.description: Value of next_cursor from the previous page.

query.description: Matches title, plan, product or domain.

name: my_apps_list
title: My apps and licences
